text:
mona: Heads up: new user reported that the Python quickstart has a few things out of sync after last week's packaging change. Putting notes here.

mona: 1) The README links to `examples/getting_started/async_quickstart.py` but file 404s on main (we moved to examples/onboarding/). Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-quickstarts/blob/main/examples/getting_started/async_quickstart.py :disappointed: 

ty: Repro'd. Path drift from rename. Small PR to update README should be fine.

kevin: 2) The async snippet that *is* shown in the docs does `from redwood import Client` and then `async with Client(...)` which crashes: `TypeError: 'Client' object is not an async context manager`.

mona: Right - AsyncClient lives in `redwood.async_client`, not exported at package root currently, so copy-paste users get the sync Client.

ty: Two quick options: export AsyncClient in `redwood/__init__.py` for discoverability OR update docs to `from redwood.async_client import AsyncClient`. I lean export it.

kevin: Also: our distributed stubs (.pyi) currently have `Client` as a combined type which confuses mypy. It often infers the sync variant and then flags the `async with` usage. We should make AsyncClient an explicit symbol in stubs.

mona: Agreed. Could cause a ton of noise for strict-type users.

qa-bot: Suggested minimal repro attached in ticket: 
```
# repro.py
from redwood import Client

async def f():
  async with Client(api_key=\"x\") as c:
    await c.generate(\"hi\")

# -> TypeError: 'Client' object is not an async context manager
```

ty: I'll open PRs: (A) fix README link, (B) export AsyncClient, (C) update example to show both sync and async imports and explicit AsyncClient usage, (D) update .pyi stubs to expose AsyncClient type.

kevin: Can we also add a short doc note near auth examples: the quickstart currently shows `retry_on_401=True` and implies token refresh will be attempted. That's only true for Dedicated with `enable_auto_refresh`. Hosted customers need to implement refresh logic or use short-lived hosted tokens. Docs should be explicit.

mona: Good catch. Add a footnote and a tiny hosted-refresh helper snippet.

ty: Also proposing a tiny CI job for python-quickstarts: run markdown link-check and run examples through a static mypy check to catch these kinds of issues earlier. Thoughts?

kevin: 👍 on both. Link-checker GH action would have caught the 404. Mypy CI for examples might be flaky but useful if we pin deps in the examples repo.

mona: I'll file the docs issue and add checklist items for release notes and changelog entry.

docs-bot: Created issue #4310: \"python-quickstarts: fix async example import, update stubs, clarify auth retry semantics, add link-checker CI\" assigned to @ty. (automated)

ty: I'll land the README link fix today, then follow up with the AsyncClient export + stubs change tomorrow. Will ping @sdk-owners for review.

kevin: If anyone takes the stubs change, ping me for review. It's small but needs coordination with packaging.

mona: Thanks all. Closing thread — follow-ups in #4310 and PRs. :rocket:

End of thread.
